description:
Configure the 'ne' (Natural Earth) workspace in GeoServer to restrict service access. 

1. Log in to the GeoServer web admin at http://localhost:8080/geoserver/web/ (credentials: admin / Admin123!).
2. Navigate to the 'ne' workspace settings.
3. Configure the services for this workspace to:
   - Disable WFS (Web Feature Service)
   - Disable WCS (Web Coverage Service)
   - Keep WMS (Web Map Service) enabled
4. In the workspace-specific WMS settings, change the Service Title to 'Natural Earth Visualization Service'.
5. Save the configuration.
